_comment: Placeholder photography, used only when a business has none of its own.
The rule that governs this file: FACTS stay theirs, VISUALS may be generic.
A demo carrying someone else's name and their real trading hours is what
earns a reply; the photography is set dressing, and every design mockup in
the trade uses placeholder imagery. So a shop with no website still gets a
What must NOT go in here: a photograph of an identifiable different
business — a rival shopfront, a recognisable interior. The owner would
reasonably read that as passing someone else's premises off as theirs, and
that is worse than a page with no pictures. Textures, ingredients, hands,
light, close crops: fine. Storefronts and staff: not.
